script:
set -eu
cd /opt/decider-open-models/ac-control/2026-10-30-h2o-official-v2
python3 - <<'CHECK'
from pathlib import Path
import json
import tune_h2o_runtime as t
root=Path('.')
original=json.loads((root/'rollback/original.json').read_text())
unit=t.command(['systemctl','cat',t.SERVICE])['stdout']
assert unit==original['effective_unit']
assert t.protected_state()==original['protected_services']
assert not t.DROPIN.exists()
assert t.health()
guard=t.command(['systemctl','is-active',t.GUARD+'.timer'],check=False)
assert guard['stdout'].strip()!='active'
result={'verified_at':t.stamp(),'exact_original_unit_restored':True,'dropin_absent':True,'protected_services_unchanged':True,'health':t.health(),'guard':guard,'effective_unit':unit,'docker_env':t.command(['docker','inspect','--format','{{json .Config.Env}}','decider-h2o-resident'])}
t.save(root/'final_inventory.json',result)
print(json.dumps(result))
CHECK
aws s3 cp final_inventory.json s3://strands-decider-vllm-632930644527/output/ac-control/2026-10-30-h2o-official-v2/results/final_inventory.json --only-show-errors
